overview.title: Overview & quick attendance
overview.description: View session details, roles and quick links, and record the current shift's check-in or check-out.

rules.0: Attendance dates and times use Vietnam time. The system records punch times when you act.
rules.1: Quick attendance uses the same data as My attendance.

profile.title: My profile
profile.description: View personal and work details, monthly attendance summaries, annual leave balances, leave history and account information.

rules.0: Actual work time is the total determined work minutes in the month; overtime is the total recorded OT minutes.
rules.1: Leave days are annual and unpaid leave applied to the timesheet. This may differ from the days shown on leave requests.
rules.2: Used leave includes approved leave in the future.

session.title: Sign in, activate & sign out
session.description: Sign in with an assigned account; activate through an invitation email if required; sign out of this session or all devices from the account section.

rules.0: Open the invitation email, follow the link to set a password, then sign in.
rules.1: Signing out of all devices requires confirmation in My profile. Public registration and a forgotten-password screen are not available.

attendance.title: My attendance
attendance.description: View shifts, record check-in/out, select a period and review daily status and history.

rules.0: The company network, an effective schedule and an eligible employee profile are required. One check-in/out pair is recorded per workday.
rules.1: A completed day has Completed status. A late/early day is counted once if either number of minutes is greater than zero.
rules.2: Overnight shifts belong to the date they start. Finish an open overnight shift before starting another.

permissions.title: Late arrival / early departure
permissions.description: Select the date, shift, period, expected time and reason; submit, edit or withdraw pending requests and view history.

rules.0: Period-based requests must stay within working hours. Use a leave request for the whole period.
rules.1: Approval marks the missing time as authorized. Work time is still reduced in 15-minute steps and annual leave is not deducted.
rules.2: Past-date requests cannot be edited. Processed requests cannot be edited or withdrawn here.

permission-review.title: Review late arrival / early departure
permission-review.description: Filter requests, check shifts and requested durations, approve or reject with a note, and view history.

rules.0: Only pending requests can be reviewed. You cannot review your own request; rejection requires a reason.
rules.1: If the shift changes, the requester must reload and update the request before approval.

corrections.title: Attendance additions / corrections
corrections.description: Submit proposed punch times after the shift ends; edit or withdraw pending requests and view history. HR/ADMIN can open the Approval inbox on the same page.

rules.0: Proposed times must be valid, within the recording window and not in the future.
rules.1: Approval recalculates attendance from the corrected times. Original times and history are retained for reconciliation. You cannot review your own request.

overtime.title: Overtime (OT)
overtime.access: Employees submit / record · HR / ADMIN review
overtime.description: Register or withdraw pending OT; HR/ADMIN review it in the Approval inbox; employees record the start and end of approved OT.

rules.0: Register and obtain approval before OT starts, with a duration under 24 hours. It must not overlap regular work or blocked leave.
rules.1: Record OT through the company network. OT is separate from regular work; pay and salary multipliers are not calculated.

shifts.title: Work shifts
shifts.description: Create, edit or deactivate shift templates; view version history; configure work intervals, recording windows and overnight shifts.

rules.0: Standard minutes equal the sum of work intervals, excluding breaks.
rules.1: Regular shifts have one or two work intervals. Overnight shifts have one interval ending the following day.
rules.2: Editing creates a new version. Recorded workdays retain their saved shift.

schedules.title: Shift assignments & schedules
schedules.description: Select employees, shift, weekdays and effective dates; preview and apply company defaults, individual schedules or replacements for everyone; view history.

rules.0: On effective dates, an employee's individual schedule takes precedence over the company default.
rules.1: Preview to check conflicts. After changing scope or shift, preview again before applying.
rules.2: Days without a shift are tracked separately and are not automatically treated as absence.

reports.title: Timesheets & CSV export
reports.description: Select a period and employee/department; view employee summaries, search names/codes, filter anomalies, open daily details, refresh leave/schedule and export CSV.

rules.0: The four top metrics and CSV cover the entire loaded period. Search, pagination and list filters do not change that scope.
rules.1: Recorded days keep a leave/schedule snapshot. When sources change, HR must refresh leave/schedule for the affected day.
rules.2: Timesheets are currently provisional, without period closing or payroll. CSV contains daily detail.

leave.title: My leave
leave.description: Submit full-day or half-day annual/unpaid leave; filter status, view details/history and withdraw pending requests.

rules.0: Start today or later. Half-day requests cover a single date. Annual leave requests cannot span two years.
rules.1: Request days currently use calendar days, including weekends and holidays, without automatic schedule exclusions.

leave-review.title: Review leave requests
leave-review.description: Review pending requests, approve or reject with notes, view history and filter for approved-leave adjustments.

rules.0: You cannot review your own request. Rejection requires a reason; annual leave is deducted only after successful approval.
rules.1: Unpaid leave and pending, rejected or withdrawn requests do not reduce annual leave.

leave-adjustments.title: Adjust approved leave
leave-adjustments.access: Request owner submits · HR / ADMIN review
leave-adjustments.description: Open an approved request to cancel all leave or shorten the remaining period; track or withdraw pending adjustments and view history.

rules.0: The original request and balance change only after another HR/ADMIN user approves the adjustment.
rules.1: The difference in annual leave is refunded. Recorded workdays need a leave/schedule refresh to receive the change.

employees.title: Manage employees
employees.description: List, create or edit profiles, contacts, emergency contacts, hire dates, departments, job titles, managers and employment status.

rules.0: Employment status and account status are separate. The profile screen does not calculate work time.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: List, create or edit department codes, names and descriptions for use in profiles and filters.

rules.0: This is a catalog; it has no metric calculation formulas.

positions.title: Job titles
positions.description: List, create or edit job title codes, names and descriptions for employee assignment.

rules.0: This is a catalog; it has no metric calculation formulas.

accounts.title: Create & provision employee accounts
accounts.description: Create an account for an existing employee profile and assign roles, or provision it from the profile and track results, activation emails and resends.

rules.0: Accounts must be linked to an employee profile. Creating an account does not create the employee profile.
rules.1: ADMIN can list accounts, change roles, lock/unlock and force sign-out in Account administration. Every change requires a reason and is audited.

calendar.title: Holidays & events
calendar.description: Browse the annual calendar, filter types, view dates/events and pending or approved personal leave, and open leave request details.

rules.0: All-day events include the end date. Timed events exclude the ending instant and are displayed in Vietnam time.
rules.1: The yearly count includes company events and personal leave overlapping the year. The monthly count includes events overlapping the month after type filtering; a multi-day event is counted once.
rules.2: Only published, all-day, company-wide holidays excuse regular work time in the timesheet.

calendar-management.title: Manage calendar
calendar-management.description: Filter events; create or edit, publish, cancel with a reason, or delete drafts.

rules.0: Unpublished drafts do not create company holidays in the timesheet. Cancelled events may remain visible with a Cancelled label.

notifications.title: Notifications & queues
notifications.description: Track pending-request badges in the menu and account creation notifications; open the relevant page to act.

rules.0: The leave badge includes pending leave and adjustment requests. The late/early badge counts pending requests in that workflow.
rules.1: Badges cover the full queue. Pending requests in a timesheet are counted only within its report period.

services.title: Service integrations
services.description: Check Authentication, Employee, Calendar, Attendance, Leave and Notification status. Check again after a connection interruption.

rules.0: Status reflects the most recent check. This page has no business calculation formulas.

accountManagement.title: Account administration
accountManagement.description: Find accounts, manage access roles and revoke login sessions.

rules.0: This action revokes all sessions for the account. The user must sign in again; requests already accepted may still complete.
rules.1: You cannot lock or change your own permissions here. Ask another ADMIN; manage your own sessions from My profile.

work-time.title: Determined credited hours
work-time.expression:
Required minutes = Scheduled minutes − Annual leave minutes − Unpaid leave minutes
Credited minutes = max(0, Required minutes − Rounded late minutes − Rounded early minutes)
work-time.explanation: Applies when valid check-in/out times are available and there are no leave/schedule conflicts. Scheduled minutes sum the shift's work intervals, excluding breaks. Only approved leave matching the date and period applies. Approved corrections replace the original punch times for calculation.
work-time.example: Shift 08:00–12:00 and 13:30–17:30: 480 minutes. Check in at 08:07, check out at 17:20, no leave → 480 − 15 − 15 = 450 minutes = 7 hours 30 minutes.

notes.0: Report totals sum determined credited minutes for employees/days in the loaded period. A day is not assumed to equal 8 hours.
notes.1: Annual leave, unpaid leave and OT are reported separately and are not added to regular work time. This is not a payroll calculation.
notes.2: A holiday or leave covering all required work, with no punches or conflicts, gives 0 work minutes. Missing/invalid times or conflicts are undetermined and excluded from totals.

rounding.title: Late arrival, early departure & 15-minute rounding
rounding.expression:
Late seconds per interval = max(0, min(Check-in, Interval end) − Interval start)
Early seconds per interval = max(0, Interval end − max(Check-out, Interval start))
Rounded minutes = ceil(Total seconds / 900) × 15
rounding.explanation: Calculate over work intervals remaining after leave. Sum late seconds across intervals before rounding; sum and round early seconds separately. ceil rounds up to an integer.
rounding.example: 1 second late → 15 minutes; exactly 15 minutes late → 15 minutes; 15 minutes 1 second late → 30 minutes. 7 minutes late and 10 minutes early → 30 minutes deducted in total.

notes.0: Authorized/unauthorized minutes are for reconciliation only. Do not add them together to replace the standard deduction formula.

actual-time.title: Actual working time within the shift
actual-time.expression: Actual seconds = Σ max(0, min(Check-out, Interval end) − max(Check-in, Interval start))
actual-time.explanation: Sum the overlap between punch times and each remaining work interval in seconds. Exclude breaks and time outside the shift. This differs from credited hours after rounding.
actual-time.example: Check in at 08:07 and out at 17:20 for a shift of 08:00–12:00, 13:30–17:30 → 463 actual minutes (7 hours 43 minutes), but 450 credited minutes (7 hours 30 minutes).

notes.0: A single check-in/out pair cannot record departures and returns during the shift.

permission-time.title: Requested late arrival / early departure duration
permission-time.expression:
Requested late time = Expected arrival − Period start
Requested early time = Period end − Expected departure
Authorized missing seconds = min(Actual missing seconds in period, Authorized minutes × 60)
Unauthorized missing minutes = ceil(max(0, Total missing seconds − Authorized seconds) / 900) × 15
permission-time.explanation: Requested duration comes from the selected date's shift. Requested minutes are rounded up to 15-minute steps for reference; authorized coverage uses the original duration of valid approved requests. Reconcile late arrival and early departure separately.
permission-time.example: Shift 13:00–15:00, approved arrival at 13:08, actual arrival at 13:16 and departure on time → deduct 30 minutes, leaving 90 credited minutes. 8 minutes are authorized; the 8 unauthorized minutes round to 15 for reconciliation.

notes.0: Approval does not restore credited hours or deduct annual leave. Requests conflicting with shifts, leave or holidays cannot provide authorized coverage.

overtime-time.title: Approved & recorded OT
overtime-time.expression:
Approved OT minutes = Approved requested duration
Recorded OT minutes = floor(max(0, min(OT check-out, Approved end) − max(OT check-in, Approved start)) / 60 seconds)
overtime-time.explanation: Count only the overlap of recorded OT with the approved interval. floor keeps whole minutes and drops remaining seconds. OT does not use the 15-minute rounding applied to regular work.
overtime-time.example: Approved 18:00–20:00 (120 minutes), recorded start 18:10 and end 20:05 → 110 recorded minutes.

notes.0: Approved OT missing a start or end has no recorded duration yet. Report OT totals include only available values.
notes.1: Overnight OT is grouped by its registered start date. Pay multipliers and overtime pay are not calculated yet.

leave-days.title: Leave days: requests and timesheets
leave-days.expression:
Full-day request: Days = End date − Start date + 1
Half-day request: Days = 0.5
Timesheet leave hours = Shift interval minutes covered by approved leave / 60
leave-days.explanation: Requests currently use calendar days, without excluding weekends/holidays. Timesheets apply leave to each day's shift; holidays and unscheduled days do not automatically become one workday or 8 leave hours.
leave-days.example: A full-day request from Friday through Sunday counts as 3 requested leave days. If only Friday has an 8-hour shift, the timesheet applies 8 leave hours, not 24.

notes.0: Timesheet leave days add 1 for full-day leave or 0.5 for half-day leave applied on each day, including annual and unpaid leave.
notes.1: A period's leave minutes depend on its length and do not always equal 4 hours.

leave-balance.title: Annual leave balance & refunds
leave-balance.expression:
Days = Half-day units / 2
Remaining leave = Entitlement − Used leave
Refund after adjustment approval = Original days − Remaining leave days
leave-balance.explanation: The system currently initializes 24 half-day units, equivalent to 12 annual leave days. Used leave increases when annual leave is approved, including upcoming dates; reductions are refunded only when adjustments are approved.
leave-balance.example: 12 days entitled, 3 approved → 9 remaining. An approved adjustment from 3 days to 1 refunds 2 days → 11 remaining.

notes.0: These are the app's current configured rules. Seniority-based or monthly prorated accrual is not implemented.
notes.1: Unpaid leave and pending requests do not reduce annual leave.

report-totals.title: Timesheet metrics & warnings
report-totals.expression:
Employees in period = Employees with data rows
Employees needing review = Employees with at least 1 review day
Determined credited hours = Sum of non-empty work minutes / 60
Recorded overtime = Sum of recorded OT minutes / 60
report-totals.explanation: A review day has missing records/check-out, invalid times, source/request conflicts, or pending leave, late/early or OT requests. A day with several issues is counted once in the review-day total.
report-totals.example: Two days with 450 and 480 work minutes and one missing check-out → 930 determined minutes = 15 hours 30 minutes, plus 1 undetermined day.

notes.0: Pending requests are deduplicated by type and ID within the employee/period scope. A multi-day request is not counted repeatedly.
notes.1: Unstarted or ongoing shifts may lack calculated time without automatically being marked as missing records. Unscheduled days are separate.
notes.2: A dash means no determined work value exists. A determined zero differs from missing data.
notes.3: Late/early days count dates with positive late or early minutes. Completed days count dates with Completed status.

getting-started.title: Getting started

steps.0: Sign in with your assigned account. If you received an invitation email, open its activation link and set a password first.
steps.1: Open My profile from the top account menu to review personal details, work information and roles.
steps.2: Check your shift in My attendance and annual leave balance in your profile. Contact HR if your profile or schedule is missing.

getting-started.note: HR and ADMIN share operational permissions; ADMIN additionally provisions and administers accounts. MANAGER has no dedicated team management or review features yet.

daily-attendance.title: Daily attendance

steps.0: Connect to the company network, open Overview or My attendance and check the displayed shift and work date.
steps.1: Choose Record check-in when starting and Record check-out when finishing within the shift's allowed window.
steps.2: Select a period to view daily records and metrics. For missing or incorrect times, submit an attendance correction after the shift ends.

daily-attendance.note: An overnight shift belongs to its start date. Work time is determined only with valid complete data; breaks and OT are excluded from regular work.

request-leave.title: Request & adjust leave

steps.0: Open My requests → My leave; select annual/unpaid leave, dates and full/half day, then enter a reason.
steps.1: Submit and track the status. Open details for history or to withdraw a pending request.
steps.2: For approved requests, open Adjust approved leave to cancel or shorten the period, then wait for another HR/ADMIN user to review it.

request-leave.note: Request days currently include weekends and holidays in the selected range. Annual leave is deducted on approval and refunded only after an adjustment is approved.

request-permission.title: Request late arrival / early departure

steps.0: Open My requests → Late arrival / early departure. Select a date to load the actual shift.
steps.1: Choose the request type, work period, expected time and reason; check the duration and submit.
steps.2: Track, edit or withdraw while pending and before the date passes. If the shift changes, reload and update the request.

request-permission.note: Approval marks the time as authorized; credited hours are still reduced in 15-minute steps. Use leave for a whole work period off.

request-overtime.title: Register & record overtime

steps.0: Open My requests → Overtime (OT); select a period outside regular hours and enter a reason.
steps.1: Submit early enough for HR/ADMIN to approve before the start.
steps.2: After approval, connect to the company network and choose Start OT within the approved interval; choose Finish OT when done.

request-overtime.note: Approved minutes are the registered limit. Recorded minutes count only the punched time within that limit.

review-requests.title: Review requests

steps.0: Open Review leave or Review late arrival / early departure from the menu. For OT and corrections, open the Approval inbox on their pages.
steps.1: Read the reason, date/shift and proposed data. For approved leave, use the Adjust approved leave filter to review changes.
steps.2: Approve or reject, providing a reason for rejection. If the data changed, reload and check it before acting.

review-requests.note: You cannot review your own requests. Menu badges help track pending items.

manage-schedule.title: Set up shifts & assignments

steps.0: Create or check a Work shifts template: work intervals, recording window and overnight option.
steps.1: Open Shift assignments & schedules; choose scope, shift, weekdays and effective dates.
steps.2: Preview, check conflicts and apply. Preview again after changing selections, and use history to verify the result.

manage-schedule.note: Individual schedules override the company schedule on effective dates. Editing a shift does not automatically change saved shifts for past recorded days.

read-report.title: Read & reconcile timesheets

steps.0: Choose From date, To date and employee/department, then Load timesheet.
steps.1: Review the summary, filter Needs review or Incomplete work time, and select an employee to see daily detail.
steps.2: If leave or holidays changed, refresh leave/schedule on recorded days. Incorrect punch times need an attendance correction request.
steps.3: Choose Export daily CSV for the full loaded period. Searching names in the table does not narrow the CSV.

read-report.note: Timesheets are provisional. Totals include only determined days and show leave and OT separately; do not treat them as finalized payroll.

manage-people.title: Manage personnel & accounts

steps.0: Prepare Departments and Job titles, then create Employee profiles with personal and work information.
steps.1: Assign department, job title and manager; check the hire date and employment status.
steps.2: Admin can provision from the profile or create an account for an existing profile. HR/Admin track results and activation emails, resending if needed.

manage-people.note: Employee employment status is different from sign-in account status.

manage-calendar.title: Publish holidays & events

steps.0: Open Manage calendar, create an event and choose its type, time and audience.
steps.1: Save a draft, review it and publish. Reopen the event to update or cancel when necessary.
steps.2: Check Holidays & events. If a company holiday changed, reconcile affected recorded attendance days.

manage-calendar.note: To excuse regular work, a holiday must be published, all-day and company-wide.

0.0: Why are credited hours lower than time present?
0.1: Only shift work intervals count, excluding breaks and time outside the shift. Late arrival and early departure are rounded up separately to 15-minute steps. OT must be registered, approved and recorded separately.

1.0: My late arrival was approved. Why is work time still deducted?
1.1: Approval marks the late/early time as authorized; it does not restore work time. The deduction formula stays the same and annual leave is not reduced.

2.0: What is the difference between “—” and 0 hours?
2.1: A dash means the value is undetermined due to missing data. Zero is a calculated result, such as a holiday without punches. Days without shifts are separate.

3.0: Leave was approved or adjusted, but the timesheet has not changed?
3.1: Recorded days retain the leave/schedule snapshot saved at that time. Ask HR to open daily details in Timesheets and refresh leave/schedule.

4.0: Unable to record attendance or seeing incorrect data?
4.1: Check the company network, shift and recording window. After a connection interruption, reload to verify the result before retrying. Check Service integrations; if problems continue, report the date and error to HR.

5.0: Why are management pages missing or access denied?
5.1: Management features require HR or ADMIN. Ask an administrator to check your roles; MANAGER does not automatically grant review permissions.
